left.title: Intel chief's shocked reaction to Putin invite (Watch)
left.body: Director of National Intelligence Dan Coats reacted to breaking news that Russian President Vladimir Putin is in talks for a visit to Washington in the fall, according to the White House.
left.roundup: Director of National Intelligence Dan Coats was surprised to hear that President Trump has invited Russian President Vladimir Putin to come to Washington in the Fall.

center.title: Incredulity as Russian leader is invited to visit US
center.body: President Donald Trump has invited Russian leader Vladimir Putin to visit the US, in a move that drew startled laughter from a US intelligence chief.
center.roundup: Director of National Intelligence Dan Coats was surprised to hear that President Trump has invited Russian President Vladimir Putin to come to Washington in the Fall.

right.title: Trump's Director of National Intelligence Was Pretty Surprised to Hear Putin Was Invited to the White House
right.body: President Trump has another date with Russia's Vladimir Putin this fall, according to The White House.
